unit.why: A short report in a letter: the Besht foretold the Kozhnitzer Maggid's birth, and R. Hayyim of Volozhin tells how he spent a whole day in pilpul with the Maggid and found him a master of the Talmud.

stories.start_quote: הגה"ק ר׳ ישראל המגיד מקאזניץ שהיה
stories.summary_en: R. Israel, the Maggid of Kozhnitz, was born late to his father after the Besht foretold a righteous son, and R. Hayyim of Volozhin testified that during his wanderings he spent a whole day in pilpul with him and found him a master of the Babylonian Talmud with Tosafot by heart, the Jerusalem Talmud and the codifiers.

tags.why: The point is to show the Maggid's greatness in Torah learning.

quotes: ועסקתי עמו כיום תמים בעמקי הפלפול
tags.why: A day of Talmudic pilpul is depicted.

quotes: מהגאון מו״ה חיים אבד״ק וולאזין ז"ל
tags.why: The mitnagdic leader R. Hayyim of Volozhin meets the Maggid and testifies about him.

quotes: שעפ"י הבעש״ט ז"ל נתבשר לו שיולד לו בן
tags.why: The Besht foretold the birth of a righteous son, and it came true.

quotes: והי' בן יחיד לאביו לעת זקנתו
tags.why: His birth in his father's old age is mentioned.

quotes: בן הרב ר׳ שבתי כורך ספרים
tags.why: His father, the bookbinder R. Shabbetai, appears.

quotes: מה ששמע מהגאון מו״ה חיים אבד״ק וולאזין
שאמר להגאון מו"ה יעקב מאיר פדוואה
tags.why: The tale reaches us through a chain of tellers.
'Maggid' here is the tsaddik's title, not a separate preacher figure, so this tag is borderline.
